fresh_checks.check: For n>=2 the symplectic wedge map makes the Lee form unique. Local multiplication by exp(-f) gives a closed positive form; deck characters and conformal class changes have the displayed signs.
On a compact manifold a nonzero parallel exact form would vanish at a maximum, a contradiction. Strictness and the nonzero constant Lee norm remain explicit.
The Levi–Civita conformal formula gives the four terms of the displayed nabla J identity with the stated signs, and the tensors descend globally.
Lambda-c has the book normalization i/(4 pi). Kappa=dc lambda=-d lambda-c is closed of type (1,1), and a change lambda+da changes kappa by -ddc a.
The Hermitian Hodge-star identity reduces dd^c omega^(n-1)=0 to co-closedness of the closed Lee form. The conformal Gauduchon representative stays LCK.
Integration by parts gives (n-1) integral lambda wedge lambda-c wedge omega^(n-1). The semipositive trace is positive wherever lambda is nonzero.
The own Gauduchon pairing proves j_X(lambda) nonzero for a strict LCK structure despite its vanishing de Rham image.

A Kähler modification would make the pullback Lee curvature dd^c-exact; degree-one pushforward and Gauduchon integration contradict the positive degree. The closed modification criterion retains its existing external scope.
A nonzero positive exact representative cannot pair with a balanced metric. Its existence is conditional on pseudoeffectivity, which requires every Gauduchon test, not just the LCK gauge.
Local conjugation gives d_lambda D_lambda=0. Expansion retains both first-order terms and the zeroth-order kappa+lambda wedge lambda-c term.
The ordinary perturbation satisfies the fixed Lee equation exactly when lambda wedge dd^c u vanishes; positive twisted perturbations always satisfy it.
The top form has character chi^n and its ratio descends after fixing the gauge. D_lambda 1 need not vanish, so scalar additive normalization is not harmless.

The descended Lee form is -ds; e^s omega=dd^c |z|^2 and the radial product metric makes it parallel. Kappa=alpha and D_lambda 1=omega. Ordinary unbounded mass does not concern only fixed-Lee perturbations.
Multiplication by e^(-a) identifies the twisted operators for lambda+da and lambda. Its constant gauge freedom is specified before comparing metrics.

Equal volume gives A^n=e^(-na) omega1^n, and the Gauduchon condition gives dd^c(e^((n-1)a)A^(n-1))=0. Ordinary scalar and Gauduchon volume theorems do not impose the same coupled geometric constraint.
With s=|lambda|^2, tau=s/(4 pi) and A=lambda-sharp/s, tau omega=eta+lambda wedge lambda-c. Eta has exactly the complex Lee-line kernel.
The connection identity makes A parallel holomorphic, B=JA holomorphic Killing, and the fields commute. Basic derivatives are horizontal and flow-invariant.
The extra differential term has transverse degree 2m+1 and vanishes. Thus the basic top transverse integral is constant without treating the transverse leaf space as a compact manifold.
The transverse wedge equation is uniformly elliptic locally with no zeroth-order term. Basicness lifts the maximum set to an open set; connected compactness makes the potential constant.
Smooth Hermitian uniqueness makes the normalized potential basic. The normalized total volume and transverse Stokes force the scalar b=0.

The changed Lee form lambda-du and transverse eta+dd^c u give a positive LCK form. The common holomorphic Killing field has closed dual one-form, forcing parallelness. Horizontal wedge terms vanish in its top volume.
Exactness and semipositivity of eta+eta-hat make its top power vanish. The kernels are complex lines, hence agree. The ratio of the nonvanishing holomorphic tangent fields is constant.
Complete fields and bounded v force a=1,b=0 and basicness. Double contraction includes n/(4 pi tau-hat^n); basic integration forces tau-hat=1 before applying transverse uniqueness.
The local conformal Ricci identity in real dimension 2n, harmonic trace condition and d(J lambda) formula give the displayed Riemannian Ricci tensor.
Divergence integration against the co-closed Lee form gives integral Ric:S=0. The trace term and integral S(A,A) vanish, leaving the displayed projection and S(B,B) terms.

The quartic terms cancel in Ric(A,A). Subtracting the Bochner integral from Bianchi gives zero anti-J-invariant squared norm; J-invariance then gives S(B,B)=S(A,A), and the remaining integral forces S=0.
Conformal Chern–Ricci flatness and the Gauduchon gauge need to hold for the same metric. Separate existence of those representatives does not solve the Calabi–Yau–Vaisman conjecture.
Dc lambda=dd^c f makes lambda+df closed for both operators, hence the real part of a closed holomorphic form. The pointed pseudoeffective cone gives C_X intersect -C_X=K_X.
Integration by parts identifies the Lee pairing. Lamari applied to both signs and finite-dimensional Poincaré duality show q_X(Z_X)=K_X-perp; positive roots give the Gauduchon metrics.

Finite positive perturbations provide openness in W_X, including W_X=0. Separation from an open convex cone gives a nonzero functional represented modulo K_X and proves the stated strict dual description.

Degree-one current pushforward is a left inverse for Bott–Chern pullback. General position moves one-cycles and bounding two-chains off the indicated Whitney strata, proving the H1 comparison and the resolution-independent cone identifications.

An open cone containing zero is its ambient space. Balanced metrics give zero; class C gives W=0. The Hopf topology and positive Lee pairing give precisely the displayed positive ray and open dual half-line.

The closed real form and bar-partial-exact definition agree by type. Its dc Gamma is exact. Hahn–Banach separation gives a nonzero positive current annihilating closed complementary tests, hence a de Rham-exact current.

A smooth closed positive-type representative bounds current trace mass by a fixed finite-dimensional cohomological functional. The converse excludes positive exact currents. Weak limits prove compactness and closedness of the image cone; positivity proves pointedness.

The complex additive action is free and proper by the two norm ratios. The smooth unit-sphere slice gives S3 times S3 and zero H1,H2,H5. The projectivization pullback is a nonzero semipositive exact rank-two form with nonzero Bott–Chern class outside the Lee image.

The balanced elliptic example has a nonzero non-pseudoeffective de Rham-kernel class and zero lower Monge–Ampère mass. Linear mass bounds imply neither cohomological injectivity nor lower nonlinear mass. All three formal LCK problems remain unchanged and open.
